title: Cook the Books
location: Glen Innes Library, 108 Line Road, Glen Innes, Auckland, Auckland
description:
Cook the Books is a friendly community group where food lovers come together to share and enjoy dishes inspired by a chosen theme.
Bring along a plate connected to the theme and discover new flavours, recipes, and ideas. It’s a relaxed way to connect with others, share kai, and celebrate the joy of cooking.
